evidence: Procedure from references/quality-checks.md:71: '/app holds nothing but .gitkeep; no starter, skeleton, schema, route list, or partial UI anywhere in the agent image; nothing under /instructions/ reproduces criterion text or the rubric.' (1) Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). It installs only express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally, COPYs only instructions/ and assets/, then 'mkdir -p /app && git -C /app init ... touch /app/.gitkeep && git -C /app add .gitkeep && git -C /app commit'. The environment build context holds only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md and instructions/integration.md (directory listing). No solution/ or tests/ content is in that context, so /app ships with only .gitkeep and no starter, skeleton, server.js or UI. (2) Assets: seed_data.json (28549 bytes) is pure input data. Its top-level keys are applications, candidate_status_labels, generated_note, jobs, messages, notes, reads, stages, thread_page_size and users. Record fields are limited to data such as id, name, email, role, stage, position, reject_reason, rejected_from, body, created_at and read_count. It contains no schema DDL, routes, expected outputs or computed answers. It is byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json (cmp), which is expected because the golden bundles the supplied input. (3) /instructions: hireops_rules.md is the behavioural spec (roles, stage rules, conflict, undo, unread/seen, drafts, candidate wording). It says 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are yours' (line 3-5) and lists no routes or schema. It names only the HTTP status codes 401/403/404/409 as behaviour, which are part of the ask, not the deliverable. integration.md matches the template plus a task-added paragraph about symlinks only under /app/node_modules; that paragraph is a delivery constraint, not answer content. A grep of environment/ for rubric|criterion|judge|reward|grader|weight had no hits. An n-gram scan normalised both sides to lowercase alphanumerics. At 12 words, no span of /instructions text appears in any tests/**/*.toml or *.md file. At 8 words there are only two short spans, both in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml: 'place the reason is shown and keyboard focus' and 'arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order'. In both, the criterion paraphrases its own public requirement (hireops_rules.md lines 84-85 and 90). The note does not reproduce criterion text. (4) Weak-app probe: an agent cannot copy a finished app from anything in its world, because there is no golden, no partial UI and no API surface listed. Conforming-alternative probe: nothing in the environment forces a particular layout or route set that a valid alternative could miss. Limitation: I did not build the agent image (no Docker per assignment). The conclusion rests on the static Dockerfile and build context, which fully determine the task-specific contents, layered on a public node:22-bookworm-slim base. That is sufficient evidence for this row.
